renders._yaml:
- component: figure
  title: Lineage calls by QC status
  description: |-
    Each bar counts the sequences assigned to a Pango lineage, split by whether they passed Pangolin's sequence quality check. It answers which lineages the run found and how many calls rest on usable sequences.
    How to read: a lineage made of passing sequences is a call to trust. Failed sequences get an unassigned lineage, so a large unassigned bar is a data quality problem and not a new variant.
    Lines and annotations: the colour is the QC status, which fails a sequence with more than 30 percent N or shorter than 25000 bases, the defaults of Pangolin's max-ambig and min-length options.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cov-lineages/pangolin/master/pangolin/command.py
  visu_type: histogram
  dict_kwargs:
    x: lineage
    color: qc_status
    labels:
      lineage: Pango lineage
      qc_status: QC status

- component: table
  title: Lineage report
  description: |-
    Each row is a sequence with its Pango lineage, the conflict and ambiguity scores, the scorpio call and its support, the Pangolin version, a note and the QC status. It answers which lineage each sequence got and how reliable the call is.
    How to read: a high ambiguity score means few sites were imputed, so the call is well supported. Read the note for alternative placements when the conflict score is above zero.
    Source: https://cov-lineages.org/resources/pangolin/output.html

- component: card
  title: Lineages found
  description: |-
    The hero number is the count of distinct Pango lineages, with the number of sequences beside it, and the bars rank the lineages by how many sequences carry them. It answers how diverse the run is and which lineages dominate.
    How to read: one dominant lineage is a single outbreak in circulation. Several lineages of similar size suggest a mixed collection, and an unassigned bar means sequences that failed the quality check.
  column: lineage
  aggregation: nunique
  aggregations:
  - count
  secondary_layout: top_n
  breakdown_col: lineage
  top_n_count: 3
  caption: sequences, by lineage
  headline: true

- component: card
  title: Sequences by QC status
  description: |-
    The hero number is the count of sequences, with the number of distinct statuses beside it, and the ring splits them into those that passed and failed Pangolin's quality check. It answers how many sequences can be trusted for lineage calling.
    How to read: a ring that is mostly pass is a healthy run. A large failed share means many sequences are too short or hold too many N bases, so check the sequencing coverage.
    Lines and annotations: a sequence fails with more than 30 percent N or fewer than 25000 bases, the defaults of Pangolin's max-ambig and min-length options.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cov-lineages/pangolin/master/pangolin/command.py
  column: qc_status
  aggregation: count
  aggregations:
  - nunique
  secondary_layout: donut
  breakdown_col: qc_status
  caption: sequences, by QC status
